reason: The free first visit means I can check for myself if it's actually clean, and the limited headcount plus the daily cleaning log is the first pitch I've seen that speaks to my toddler-chews-everything worry. Options in Salisbury are thin and I need somewhere to go between naps, so if it holds up I'd come a few times a month.
objection: I don't trust a cleaning log until I've seen it. If the toys look grubby or the place gets crowded on my first visit, I won't go back, and I won't pay for a pack up front.
